question: How do brochures and leaflets differ from posters in community health education?

options.A: They provide more detailed information in portable, handout formats for individual review
options.B: They can only be displayed on clinic walls and never taken home
options.C: They contain no text whatsoever, relying entirely on sound

explanation: Brochures and leaflets provide more detailed, portable information that community members can take home and review at their own pace. [learn more](GNS124_U5_T5#GNS124_U5_T5_h3)

question: What does rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) typically involve for high-risk animal exposures?

options.A: A single dose of oral vitamins
options.B: A specific series of rabies vaccinations and rabies immune globulin
options.C: Surgical amputation of the affected digit
options.D: Topical application of hydrogen peroxide daily

explanation: Rabies PEP combines passive immunization using rabies immune globulin with active immunization through a series of rabies vaccines. [learn more](GNS221_U3_T11#GNS221_U3_T11_h6)
